history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends the Administration finalize the forthcoming policy provisions on the management of liens, indicating clearly the definitions, types, conditions, applicability, and duration, among others, in order to ensure clarity, consistency and compliance.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. The newly promulgated administrative instruction on administration of appointments (ST/AI/2025/3), dated 9 October 2025, served to establish a consolidated and comprehensive framework for lien management, including clear definitions, conditions, applicability and duration. By serving to codify these provisions in a single, authoritative instruction applicable across the Secretariat, the policy ensures clarity, consistency and compliance. The Office of Human Resources also issued a policy guideline on lien management (OHR/PG/2026/2) to further clarify the policy provisions to ensure consistency.
history.board_assessment: Given that the administrative instruction on administration of appointments (ST/AI/2025/3) was promulgated on 9 October 2025, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
